tagline: Flagship kitchen-sink CurseForge modpack with 400+ mods, extensive quests, and custom ATM Star & Gregstar endgame
description:
All the Mods 9 (ATM9) is one of the most popular flagship modpacks on CurseForge (with over 13 million downloads) built for Minecraft 1.20.1 by the ATMTeam. It brings together over 400 carefully curated tech, magic, exploration, automation, and building mods alongside custom configuration scripts for stability.

ATM9 features a massive guided questbook and a true custom endgame: players progress through dozens of deep tech and magic trees to craft the iconic ATM Star, or take on the ultimate engineering challenge of the Gregstar.
features: Over 400 curated mods with custom recipes and performance tuning for 1.20.1
Comprehensive step-by-step questbook guiding beginners and veterans alike
True custom endgame: craft the ATM Star and take on the Gregstar challenge
Open configuration repository and active issue tracker on GitHub
